Q1.rationale: The NDA has no reverse engineering prohibition; segment 20-21 bars using Confidential Information as a basis for designing similar systems, which is a different restriction.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segments 25 and 26 require return within 15 days of written demand or after the review decision, not upon termination of the Agreement, which has no termination clause.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 34 states that neither party grants any right or license to Confidential Information by virtue of disclosure.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: The NDA contains no confidentiality obligation over the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Segments 7 and 9 extend Confidential Information to products, systems, business topics and any information regardless of form, which is incompatible with a technical-only scope.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segment 9 covers all information provided regardless of form and contains no requirement that the Disclosing Party expressly identify it.
Q6.label: NotMentioned

Q7.rationale: The NDA has no express survival clause and no stated term; segment 36 only binds successors and assigns.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: The NDA does not permit independent development; segment 21 restricts designing similar systems that use Confidential Information as a basis, which is not an independent development carve-out.
Q8.label: NotMentioned

Q9.rationale: Segment 26 requires return of all information without retaining any copies, which excludes retention after return.
Q9.label: Contradiction

Q10.rationale: Segment 9 expressly includes oral information within Confidential Information.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation covenant regarding Disclosing Party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 17 bars disclosure to any person without express written consent, so sharing with third parties (including consultants or advisors) is permitted only with consent; no category is named.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 16 bars reproduction without express written consent, so copying is permitted with that consent as a carve-out.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: The NDA has no clause requiring notice to the Disclosing Party when disclosure is compelled by law or process.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q15.rationale: The NDA excludes only public-domain information and does not address information acquired from a third party.
Q15.label: NotMentioned

Q16.rationale: Segment 18 permits internal dissemination to officers and employees who have a need to know.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 19 prohibits any use of Confidential Information without express written consent, which is stricter than a restriction to the stated purposes.
Q17.label: Entailment
